post.title: Americans Now Expect 3.9% Inflation, a 3-Year High
post.ig:
Americans expect prices to jump 3.9% over the next year.
That's the highest one-year inflation expectation since May 2023, per the New York Fed's September Survey of Consumer Expectations, released Oct 7, 2026.
It was 3.4% in March and 3.6% in August. The Fed's inflation goal is 2%.
The five-year outlook held at 3.0%; the three-year rose to 3.3%.
Sources: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Bloomberg, CNBC.
News and education, not financial advice.
